estimand: Does PREVIOUS-BIRTH-YEAR source natal nestling marking volume improve later first-year OBSERVED migrant destination probabilities beyond frozen historical movement topology?

cohort_split.historical: 1994–2013 natal birth year TRAIN both source output and historical movement routes
cohort_split.future: 2015–2021 natal nestling cohort counts as time-t observable predictor; test NEXT calendar year 2016–2022 recorded migrants only; no year 2022 nestlings as t predictor
cohort_split.years_with_no_test_migrants: show zero immigration events and omit from conditional destination logloss; do not redefine sample

identity: Only unique original mark ID with exactly one stage=nest birth island/year in fixed 11 island universe; t+1 target stage capt/obs and exactly one destination island; no unobserved migrant imputation or death inference

forecast_model.observed_source_supply_Nit: count unique stage=nest marked individuals from source island i in birth year t, regardless of resighting at t+1; *not true nestling production or ecological viable adults*
forecast_model.historic_source_yield_h_i: (259-era observed 1994-2013 emigrants from i + 0.5) / (historical 1994-2013 unique marked nestling counts i + 1); fixed Jeffreys smoothing, outcome-detection confounded
forecast_model.destination_conditionals: Same v1.241 P0 (historical recipient popularity), H (farm/nonfarm same-class historical ridge beta), R2 (undirected pair with tau10 H prior), C2 (directed with tau10 R2 prior); train only 1994-2013 historical source and destination outcomes
forecast_model.static_destination_prob: for each target j: normalized sum over i!=j of historical mean marked natal_i × historical source emigrant yield_i × historically trained route probability P(j|i)
forecast_model.dynamic_destination_prob: for each target j in future year t: normalized sum over i!=j of observed known-at-t marked natal_i,t × historical emigrant yield_i × same historically trained P(j|i)
forecast_model.time_lag: predict next-year t+1 documentation using t marked natal source volume. Never use t+1 destination abundance, resight effort or any t+1 response as feature
forecast_model.primary_comparison: R2-route forecast dynamic minus static mean negative log destination probability over all 173 next-year observed migrants born 2015-2021, negative supports incremental predictive source-output information
forecast_model.report: All 7 test natal birth years, all 11 source annual natal count arrays, 11 receiving island results, each route static/dynamic heldout log-loss, each year's signed delta; no posthoc year or origin subgroup promotion

limitations: Already-published cohort outcomes and same single archipelago, not independent confirmatory evidence
Observed marked nestling counts are strongly affected by effort and do not directly measure true donor demographic viability
Conditional-on-observed-migrant destination cannot estimate source extinction, failed emigration or population rescue
Historical 2021 study already documented effects of population size and recruit production on migration
Route R2 (habitat and pair) is NOT physically distance-adjusted; v1.243 original distance file access stopped API401/website403
N_corr includes whole-period model fit and is intentionally NOT used as a lagged prospective feature
If source marking effort varies annually, apparent dynamic prediction may be observation process
